# Custom Installations

> > Custom Installations provides premium roofing, siding, and gutter services across Illinois and Wisconsin, specializing in James Hardie fiber cement siding, wood roofing systems from Brava and DaVinci, and advanced gutter protection solutions.

Custom Installations is an award-winning exterior contractor serving the Midwest region with expertise in residential and commercial roofing systems, including cedar shake and synthetic wood options, along with comprehensive gutter maintenance and fiber cement siding installation featuring ColorPlus Technology and Engineered for Climate solutions.

## Key Topics

- James Hardie fiber cement siding
- Brava synthetic roofing
- DaVinci roofing products
- Cedar shake roofing
- Micro Mesh gutter guards
- Perf-Flow gutter protection
- Filter-Flow XT systems
- ColorPlus Technology
- Engineered for Climate
- Commercial roofing services
- Church and steeple restoration
- Illinois and Wisconsin markets
- Premium roofing systems
- Gutter cleaning and maintenance

## Roofing Services

- [Wood Roofing](https://www.custominstallations.com/roofing-services/types-of-roofing/wood-roofing): Wood roofing services featuring cedar shake and synthetic options by Brava
- [Church Roofing](https://www.custominstallations.com/roofing-services/commercial-roofing/church-roofing): Commercial church roofing and steeple restoration services
